title: Cogito
tagline: Break out, set a score, rep your hostel.
summary: You play a robot trying to break out of a facility of your own kin. Room layouts, enemies and upgrades are randomly generated, so every run is different. Our website game for Milan 2026.
linkText: About Cogito and its final standings
alt: Cogito's robot squaring up to a red armoured boss

title: Drippi Droppo
tagline: One tiny droplet vs. the environment.
summary: A short, punishing 2D physics platformer starring a droplet just trying to get from one end of a level to the other. One wrong move and it's back to the start.
alt: Drippi Droppo: a blue pixel-art droplet in a lilac level, with the hint “AD to move, W to jump”

title: PyroFrost
tagline: Hot and cold — never both at once.
summary: A fast, grid-based puzzle-arcade game for phones. Your ball switches between fire and ice; touch a tile that clashes with your element and it's game over.
alt: PyroFrost: the lava ball rolling across dark hexagon tiles over a field of lava

title: Rowmance
summary: A co-op rage game over a local network: you and a friend each take one paddle and have to sync up to steer a single boat through checkpoint courses without flipping, fighting the current, or ruining your friendship.
alt: Rowmance's title screen: two rowers in a wooden boat on a jungle river

title: Milan 2025 Website Game
summary: The inter-hostel website game for Milan 2025: sign in with your college email, find five hidden minigames and score as much as you can. Each hostel's top 50 scores added up.
alt: The hooded hero walking through a moonlit courtyard lit by fireflies
